ideas.title: FBI's evidence refusal in Alex Pretti shooting sparks controversy
ideas.description: Investigate the reasons behind the FBI's refusal to share evidence in the Alex Pretti shooting investigation and its implications for federal-state cooperation.
ideas.angle: In-depth analysis of the FBI's decision and its impact on the investigation
questions: What are the reasons for the FBI's refusal?
How will this impact the investigation?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential patterns of interference or obstruction in federal-state investigations, and explore the implications for justice and accountability.

ideas.title: Government shutdown: Impacts on critical programs and services
ideas.description: Examine the effects of the government shutdown on critical programs and services, including TSA and DHS.
ideas.angle: In-depth analysis of the shutdown's impact on government services
questions: What are the impacts on critical programs?
How will this affect public safety?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal vulnerabilities in government programs and services during shutdowns, and explore potential solutions to mitigate these impacts.
